decisions.reason: A high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits at the core of the firm's established coding offer, was launched only in 2018, and fits its growth and traceability strategy, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
The numbering software module costs little to maintain, adds value to the existing inkjet hardware for variable-data printing, and supports the firm's push toward serialization and digitalization.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the core inkjet portfolio to a large market need, drives demand for consumables, and is too new to have run its course.
